simple.summary: חָם (châm) means a father-in-law (as in affinity) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 4 19.

definitions.full: H2524. cham II. חָם husband's father , see חמה . II. [ חָם ] noun masculine husband's father (Late Hebrew id. , of husband's or wife's father, so Aramaic חֲמָא ; Arabic husband's male relation (father, brother, paternal uncle), but also wife's father , etc.; Ethiopic Assyrian êmû , Zim BP 48 ); — only suffix חָמִ֫יךָ Gen 38:13 , 25 , of Judah as Tamar's father-in-law; חָמִיהָ 1Sam 4:19 , 21 of Eli, father-in-law of Phinehas' wife.
